findings.passage: The U.S. Constitution guarantees the right to own firearms. Gun safety, not restrictions, should be the focus. Available gun safety courses teach responsible use and the role of firearms in protection and hunting. With proper education, guns are safe—the responsibility lies with the user. Criminals will break laws regardless of restrictions, while law-abiding citizens risk losing the ability to defend themselves and provide for their families through hunting if ownership is limited.
